about: E7 arm D: arm C's two test-packet lines (the step's product diff since the item base, written whole to RUN/scratch/test-diff-<item>.patch, and the repository's existing tests of the files the step changed) on today's duty and oracle placeholder, so C's gain on E7-K2 can be told apart from P's duty text. Written against 7fce12e4 (arm A).

if state["status"] != "active" or state.get("active_improve") or work_item is None or stage != "document":

edits.new:
if state["status"] != "active" or state.get("active_improve") or work_item is None or stage not in ("document", "test"):
        return []
    if stage == "test":
        # E7 arm C (docs/shiploop-test-stage-prompt-design-2026-10-30.md section 6c): the test packet names the step's
        # product diff, written whole under RUN/scratch, and the repository's existing tests of the files it changed.
        changed, why = item_scope.changed_paths_or_reason(root, work_item)
        if changed is None:
            return [CHANGED_SINCE_BASE + "not computed: " + why]
        product = [path for path in changed if not path.startswith("docs/")
                   and item_scope.classify(path) not in ("test", "docs", "config")]
        base = lint.read_base(Path(root), work_item) or {}
        top, lead = Path(base.get("toplevel") or "."), str(base.get("prefix") or ".").rstrip("/")
        lead = "" if lead in (".", "") else lead + "/"
        lines = []
        diff_path = Path(root) / "scratch" / ("test-diff-" + work_item + ".patch")
        index = Path(root) / "lint" / "tmp" / ("e7-" + uuid.uuid4().hex + ".index")
        try:
            current = lint.snapshot_tree(top, Path(root), index, prefix=str(base.get("prefix") or "."))
            diff = lint._git(top, "diff-tree", "-p", "--no-renames", base["tree"], current, "--",
                             *[lead + path for path in product]) if product else None
            if diff is not None and not diff.returncode:
                diff_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                diff_path.write_bytes(diff.stdout)
                lines.append("The step's product diff since the item base (script-derived, whole): " + str(diff_path)
                             + " (" + ", ".join(product) + ").")
            listed = lint._git(top, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", base["tree"])
            tests = [name[len(lead):] for name in listed.stdout.decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").splitlines()
                     if name.startswith(lead) and item_scope.classify(name[len(lead):]) == "test"] if not listed.returncode else []
        except (lint.LintError, KeyError):
            return [CHANGED_SINCE_BASE + ", ".join(changed)]
        finally:
            if index.exists():
                index.unlink()
        def stem(path: str) -> str:
            name = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
            for suffix in (".test", ".spec", "_test", "-test", "test_"):
                name = name.replace(suffix, "")
            return name.split(".", 1)[0]
        stems = {stem(path) for path in product}
        examples = sorted(path for path in tests if stem(path) in stems) or sorted(tests)[:1]
        if examples:
            lines.append("Example tests (the repository's existing tests of the files this step changed; follow their "
                         "layout, helpers and assertion style): " + ", ".join(examples) + ".")
        return lines
